effectiveExcludedKeywords: Any change to B-8df9 beyond deleting the three obsolete CHK-004 waiver rows

Any skip keyed on a bare status string. An item is skippable ONLY through withdrawnChecklistItemIdsFrom(decision), which requires decision==='confirmed' AND userConfirmed===true. Routing through core/checklist-status.ts is forbidden: it has zero decisionRef awareness and would yield a gate anyone can bypass by editing one JSON field
Deriving the checklist-status consumer set to prevent recurrence; raised and deliberately declined here, tracked as its own follow-up because it is a codebase-wide audit rather than a gate fix
Mutating acceptance bindings, or unfreezing proofstory_contract_set from its PLAN-only classification
Weakening either gate for items that are NOT withdrawn; the review-completeness and normal-channel disciplines stay strict
